decision_conditions: The proposed development would introduce a discernibly modern double-glazed appearance within the proposed gable end and by widening the central dormer by relocating the chimney stack which would materially and unacceptably detract from the character and appearance of the application premises, to the detriment of the surrounding area. The proposal would neither preserve, nor enhance the special character of the Gidea Park Conservation Area and is therefore contrary to Policies 26 and 28 of the Havering Local Plan, Policy HC1 of the London Plan and NPPF

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mr Sangwan (Agent) by e-mail on 25/03/26.
description: Loft conversion with dormers and rooflights to rear and alteration of roof to rear from hip to gable
